purpose: Drive a steady, repeatable generation long enough for the power sampler to take several readings, so a run's energy estimate integrates over real work rather than over idle.

passage.description: Filler text sized to the prompt length under test, so prompt evaluation and decode both draw power.

instruction.description: What to generate, including the requested output length that keeps the device busy for a measurable interval.

expectations: Any text. This prompt measures what the work cost in joules, never whether the answer is right.

metadata.author: suite
metadata.change_reason: First version: native.energy needs a workload of its own so the integrated estimate describes a known amount of work.
